title: The Silent Sentinel
template:
The Great Peak has sat in silence for many [plural_time_unit]. It watches the clouds drift by like white fluff against the sky. Its stony face is covered in soft, green [natural_substance] that feels like a velvet blanket.

One morning, a small traveler began to [action_verb] up the steep, winding path. They carried nothing but a heavy heart and a curious spirit. The mountain stood tall and watched the world spin by.

As the sun set, the traveler sat on a flat rock and felt a deep [feeling]. The ancient mountain whispered a secret through the rustling pine needles. To be truly still is to find the most powerful [source_of_power] in the universe.

blanks.hint: a noun of strength or essence
